cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the SEO Reporting Specialist position. As a digital marketer with a strong technical foundation and a passion for data-driven optimization, I am confident that my skills and experience align perfectly with the requirements of this role.

In my current position as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my abilities in on-page SEO, keyword research, and content strategy. I regularly use tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console to track performance and guide decisions. My work involves not only implementing SEO best practices but also analyzing results to refine strategies and improve organic visibility for client websites.

One of my proudest achievements is my personal project, mirook.com, where I designed and built a WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to enhance visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Through iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, I measurably improved the site's search-health score, demonstrating my ability to deliver tangible results.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it emphasizes analysis, strategy, and continuous improvement—areas where I excel. I thrive on turning data into actionable insights and am committed to helping businesses achieve their SEO goals. My background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) gives me a unique perspective on technical SEO, and my experience with content management and social media integration ensures a holistic approach.

I am eager to bring my expertise in SEO reporting and analytics to your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
